messages:
marta: Quick sync — we need a short dry-run focused on mic checks, Q&A pocket guides, and fallback flows for the webinar. Can folks do a 20-min rehearsal sprint tomorrow?
jim: yes for me, prefer morning. can we lock 9:30am PT?
leo: works. I'll run the green room audio checklist.
sophia: I can run the QA pocket guide + prioritize top 6 audience questions. will draft tonight.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite pending — created provisional 'Webinar Dry-run' block for 2024-09-18 16:30 UTC.
marta: @sophia thx — top 6 should map to model/cost/latency/regulatory/examples/use-cases. Keep answers <45s.
jim: fallback plan idea: if hosted model latency spikes, switch demo to pre-rendered short clips + share a live console screenshot. simple script: 
```
if latency > 2s/token for 2min:
  switch_demo_mode('pre-rendered')
  notify('#presentation','demo switched to pre-rendered clip')
```
leo: love that. i'll prep a 60s pre-recorded clip showing the same outputs. where do we store it? s3 or drive?
sophia: put on internal drive + publish to staging CDN link. share links in green room doc.
marta: Assign roles:
- host: jim
- demo lead: alex (hi alex?)
- QA lead: sophia
- green room tech: leo
- comms: marta
Alex: yep, I can run the demo and have a canned 2-step fallback (pre-render + screenshot).
jim: run-of-show (draft) — please skim: 
```
00:00 - intro + framing (jim, 3m)
03:00 - benchmark narrative + quick graph (marta, 4m)
07:00 - live demo (alex, 8m)
15:00 - fallback demo clip if needed (alex, 2m)
17:00 - customer story + lessons (leo, 5m)
22:00 - live Q&A (sophia moderates, 10m)
32:00 - CTA + wrap (jim, 3m)
```
sophia: This looks tight but ok. For Q&A — we'll surface a pinned doc with the top 12 anticipatory answers, but only read top 6. Keep others as follow-ups.
leo: Mic checklist I'll run tomorrow:
- mics on + levels
- noise gate check
- screenshare resolution
- confirm CDN link for clip
- verify stage host is co-presenter
marta: Two operational asks: 1) add a short slide that explains our fallback hierarchy (hosted -> dedicated -> pre-render) with simple bullet explaining tradeoffs, 2) confirm CDN link in green room doc before rehearsal.
jim: I'll update slides 1 and 2 and add the fallback slide. uploading now to the drive folder: https://drive.company/webinar/1729990001
ops-bot: New file uploaded by jim: drive.company/webinar/1729990001/slide_fallback_v1.pptx
sophia: Drafting QA pocket guide now — will post in thread when done. expect ~6 bullets per question, 2 suggested short answers, 1 follow-up resource link.
alex: For demo robustness, I'll script deterministic prompt + warm cache steps: 
1) warm prefix cache with 3 calls
2) fixed seed prompt for predictable output
3) log token timing for first 20 tokens
I'll paste the script in the green room doc.
leo: can someone add a brief note on what to say if a latency alert goes off during demo? one-liner for host to calm audience.
marta: host line: "We're seeing a brief infrastructure hiccup; while we resolve it we'll surface the same results via a short clip so the demo continues uninterrupted." Keep calm, no ops jargon.
jim: Good. Let's trial the host line during rehearsal.
sophia: ETA for QA pocket guide: 9pm PT tonight. sharing link after final pass.
ops-bot: Calendar invite updated: attendees [marta,jim,leo,sophia,alex], location: Zoom (greenroom link in calendar).
marta: Final ask — after rehearsal, capture a tiny postmortem in the thread: 3 bullets: what went well, 1-2 action items, and any slide swaps. we'll use that to lock marketing copy for the landing page.
jim: cool. See you all 9:30am PT. :thumbsup:
